title: Subscription for the STEPN (GMT) Token Sale on Binance Launchpad Is Now Open
text: Fellow Binancians, Subscription for the STEPN (GMT) token sale on Binance Launchpad is now open and will remain open for 3 hours. Users can check their eligibility and commit their BNB to the  STEPN (GMT) token sale  based on their past 7-day average BNB holdings. The BNB rate for the GMT token sale has been set below. After the subscription is complete, Binance will list STEPN (GMT) in the innovation zone and open trading for GMT/BTC, GMT/USDT, GMT/BUSD and GMT/BNB trading pairs at 2022-03-09 12:00 PM (UTC). Further information: 1 GMT = 0.00002514 BNB or 0.01 USD (using a BNB price of 397.9 USD). Users will have 3 hours to subscribe by committing their BNB tokens between 2022-03-09 06:00 AM (UTC) and 2022-03-09 09:00 AM (UTC). Users must also sign the GMT Token Purchase Agreement prior to committing their BNB. The maximum amount of BNB that each user can commit has been calculated based on their past 7-day  average BNB balance . Important:  Only BNB in user spot wallets can be used to commit. If your BNB is in other accounts such as Launchpool or BNB Vault, you will need to redeem them to your spot wallet first before committing. Please note that once committed, your BNB will be  locked  and you will not be able to redeem or access any other functions such as transfers, withdrawals or trading until final token distribution.  After the subscription period ends at 2022-03-09 09:00 AM (UTC), the GMT token allocation calculation will begin and will take a total of one hour. The final GMT token allocation results will be revealed at 2022-03-09 10:00 AM (UTC), at which point the respective BNB will be deducted from your already-locked BNB amount within 30 minutes. Once deducted, your GMT and remaining BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet. Reminder: There is a hard cap of 15,000 USD (1,500,000 GMT or 37.6980 BNB) that can be allocated per user. For detailed calculation rules, click  here .  The STEPN (GMT) SPL smart contract is available  here  and BEP-20 smart contract is available  here . Launchpad Subscription Format FAQ Please note that Binance Labs has an investment interest in STEPN. Reminder: Users need to complete their account verification and also be from an eligible jurisdiction to participate in this token sale.  * Users from the following countries or regions will not be able to participate in token sales on the Binance Launchpad platform:  Belarus, People's Republic of China, Democratic Republic of Congo, Cuba, Iraq, Iran, North Korea, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, United States of America and its territories (American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands), Zimbabwe.
